free_text: The decision to recommend a biopsy is supported by the upward trajectory in PSA levels (9.2 ng/mL) and the PI-RADS 4 assessment, despite the prior negative biopsy. Although the Digital Rectal Examination was normal, the rising PSA necessitates further investigation to rule out clinically significant prostate cancer. Therefore, a biopsy is recommended to re-evaluate the clinical status of the prostate.
